GND: Common ground: the bottom-layer copper pour. Every signal is measured against it.
LOAD: Battery / power-path rail from the charger (3.0–4.4 V): controller, mesh radio, boost input, buzzer.
5V: Switched 5 V from the boost: RockBLOCK V_IN+ and the pod's particle and methane sensors.
3V3: The Feather's 3.3 V regulator output: logic, expander, Qwiic chain, e-paper, pod I²C sensors.
SDA: I²C data: Feather ↔ expander ↔ Qwiic chain ↔ sensor pod.
SCL: I²C clock, driven by the Feather.
BOOST_EN: Expander GP0 → boost EN. HIGH turns the 5 V rail on.
MODEM_TX: UART 1: Feather TX → RockBLOCK RXD (pin 14), 230400 baud.
MESH_TX: UART 2: Feather A0 → mesh radio RXD1.
MESH_RX: UART 2: mesh radio TXD1 → Feather A1.
CH4_TX: UART 3: Feather A2 → methane sensor RX (via pod cable).
CH4_RX: UART 3: methane sensor TX → Feather A3.
SOS_SW: SOS switch line, pulled up by R1; the switch pulls it to ground.
SOS_IN: Filtered SOS line into D5 (wakes the ESP32-S3 from deep sleep).
BUZ_K: Buzzer low side, switched by Q1.
POD_OUT: Pod LED / vibration low side, switched by Q2.
